scripts.build:electron: npm run build:main && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.build:electron:win: npm run build:main && npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.test:desktop: node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/desktop-regressions.test.mjs tests/transition-regressions.test.mjs tests/update-contract.test.ts tests/update-preferences.test.ts tests/release-history.test.ts tests/cross-project-clipboard.test.ts tests/performer-grouping.test.ts tests/stage-grid-behavior.test.ts tests/three-interaction.test.ts
scripts.test:release: node --test tests/release-model.test.mjs tests/change-intent.test.mjs tests/version-packages.test.mjs tests/release-artifacts.test.mjs tests/release-workflows.test.mjs tests/published-index.test.mjs tests/publish-cos.test.mjs tests/deployment-workflows.test.mjs tests/rollback-workflow.test.mjs
scripts.release:dry-run: npm run validate:release-data && npm test && npm run build:electron:win && node scripts/release/verify-release-artifacts.mjs --allow-unsigned
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:release && npm run test:backend && npm run test:project && npm run test:desktop && npm run build
